## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or personal data (locations, emails, tokens) in the diff
- [ ] New config is read from environment variables, not hardcoded
- [ ] Docs updated if this changes how something is run or deployed
